subject: fix memory leak at config get (#388)
reason: The change rewrites OnGetStringConfig, the CONFIG GET callback for string-typed module configs in vmsdk (caching the ValkeyModuleString instead of leaking a fresh one per call). That callback is only installed by config::String::Register, and valkey-search at this commit never instantiates a config::String: every registered config (query-string-bytes, hnsw-block-size, reader/writer-threads, use-coordinator, skip-rdb-load, log-level, enable-partial-results, the ft-create limits, max-indexes, etc.) is a Number, Boolean or Enum, whose get callbacks the diff does not touch; StringBuilder/config::S
